title: fix(metadata-protocol): a list view column naming a field its object lacks reads with a _diagnostics warning
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi99h6MEVzpXRsAjxVnskDK3D)_
Fixes #31866

Clause-②: no. `_diagnostics.warnings` gains entries in its existing shape. Measured: base answers `{ valid: true }` for the card's view, head answers `{ valid: true, warnings: [2 entries] }`, every save and publish answer is byte-identical.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：元数据接口读取视图时，列表视图的某一列引用了对象上不存在的字段，现在会在 `_diagnostics.warnings` 里点名这一列(单条读、带包读、分层读三条路都有)。
- 为什么改：插件代码注册的列表视图从不经过保存，读出来一直是"有效"，打开列表时查询被拒(400)，页面看不出是哪一列错了；表单视图早已有同类警告。
- 风险与回滚：只多出警告，`valid` 不变，保存和发布的行为不变(原本就拒绝 422);回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/metadata-diagnostics.ts` 的 `withListViewFieldWarnings` 与 `withPublishVerdict` 去重那几行，再看 `protocol-meta-item-reads.ts` 的 `serveViewLint`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.form-layout-diagnostics.test.ts`,预期 20 个用例全绿，其中 #31866 一组 8 个。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The read.** `withListViewFieldWarnings` (new, `metadata-diagnostics.ts`) runs `@objectstack/lint`'s `validateListViewFieldRefs` on the body a view read serves and adds each `list-view-field-unknown` finding to `_diagnostics.warnings` as `{ path, message }`, in the rule's own words. No second rule, no `code` key. It is judged against the objects the door's own `registry.getObject` answers for the names the body spells, the universe the form pass already uses. Handed no options, the rule skips a list view whose object does not resolve, so there is no false warning there.
- **Where.** `withViewLintWarnings` composes it after `withFormLayoutWarnings`, and the three read exits that ran the form pass now run both: `getMetaItem`'s served exits (active, after the ADR-0047 reference merge, and the two draft exits), and `getMetaItemLayered`. The execution face is unchanged (it serves no `_diagnostics`).
- **Shapes.** Every list-view shape the rule walks: a list `ViewItem` (`config.columns...`), the flattened list overlay (`columns...`), a container's `list` and its `listViews.KEY`.
- **One finding, one entry.** Two guards:
  - A finding at a path the served `_diagnostics` already reports as an error (the ADR-0047 `reference_not_found` check on `userFilters`) is not repeated as a warning.
  - `withPublishVerdict` drops a prior warning that a publish refusal repeats (same path, same message). This keeps the stored-draft read exactly as on base: the gate already refuses `list-view-field-unknown` (error tier), so that read carries it once, as the error.
- **Write doors unchanged.** Step 0 measured that an active save and a publish of a stored list view naming an unknown column already answer `422 INVALID_METADATA` carrying `list-view-field-unknown` (the reference-integrity suite, `runtimeTypes` including `view`). The card's item 2 is therefore already met on `main`, as a refusal; this PR adds no advisory and no refusal there, and pins the existing answer beside the read.

## Tests

One new top-level `describe` in the existing shared harness `protocol.form-layout-diagnostics.test.ts` (no new file, no new engine double). 8 cases:

- The card's view (`cost_total` on `ai_traces`, a container with `list` and `listViews.by_model`, code-registered): single, package-scoped and layered reads each answer `{ valid: true, warnings: [list.columns.1.field, listViews.by_model.columns.1.field] }`, messages compared to the rule run in the test.
- A list `ViewItem` and the flattened overlay, code-registered: warned on all three reads at their own path.
- A stored list view whose object later lost the field: active and layered reads warn.
- A `userFilters` field the ADR-0047 check reports as an error: one error, no repeated warning.
- Save (active) and publish keep answering `422 INVALID_METADATA` with `list-view-field-unknown`; the draft read reports the column once, as that refusal.
- CONTROL: valid list views (an extension field among the columns) read `{ valid: true }` on all three reads.
- CONTROL: an object the door cannot resolve gets no warning.
- CONTROL: a container's form warning beside a valid list is unchanged on all three reads.

No existing test was edited.

## Acceptance notes

- Card item 3 (the console naming the field from the 400) is `domain:ui` and out of this card. Suggestion for the seat: a `domain:ui` card so the "query was rejected" state names the field from the `INVALID_FIELD` error.
- The rule's other list-view findings (`list-view-field-dotted`, `list-view-object-unknown`, the kanban lane ones) are not served on the read; the card and claim scope the read to `list-view-field-unknown`.

## Verification

```text
  getMetaItemLayered          _diagnostics {"valid":true}
code-registered form naming "nope": all three reads carry the form-field-unknown warning
stored list ViewItem:
  active save   -> 422 INVALID_METADATA, issues [list-view-field-unknown, severity error]
  draft save    -> 200; draft read {"valid":false,"errors":[{"path":"config.columns.1.field",...,"code":"list-view-field-unknown"}]}
  publish       -> 422 INVALID_METADATA
```
</details>
